sources: https://montanawalleyesunlimited.net/fresno-cam/ (the entry's website: a webcam page only)
note: Public campground on the SE end of Fresno Reservoir (Bureau of Reclamation land ~14 mi west of Havre), maintained by the nonprofit Fresno Chapter of Walleyes Unlimited, which also runs a webcam and weather station there. Drive-in RV/tent sites; chapter has been adding electric for campers. --Claude
summary: No operator or agency page describes this campground: the website is a Walleyes Unlimited webcam page (it confirms only that the 'Fresno Walleyes Campground' is on the SE end of the reservoir), the chapter page is login-only, and Reclamation's Fresno page lists 0 campgrounds but no fees. Recorded the no-fee statement (free, as derived). Not stated by any operator page: sites, toilets, FCFS, 14-day limit (derived values left). Note trimmed of restated values. Fees not written: Reclamation's "Campgrounds no" fee line sits beside "Campgrounds 0 / Campsites 0", so it says nothing about this site.
flags: Presence: no operator or agency page for the campground itself. The entry's website (https://montanawalleyesunlimited.net/fresno-cam/) is a webcam page; the Fresno Chapter page needs a login; Reclamation's Fresno Reservoir page (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/frrrec.html) lists Campgrounds 0 / Campsites 0. Only Visit Montana's directory describes 'tent and trailer sites', toilets, no drinking water and a 14-day limit. A human should decide whether this stays.
Missing phone: Reclamation's Montana office for Fresno, (406) 759-5077 (usbr.gov page; Visit Montana gives the same number).
Website should probably be Reclamation's page https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/frrrec.html rather than (or beside) the webcam page.
